footer.t: Commentary text is transcribed from your scanned al-Ṭībī, Mirqāt and Lamaʿāt volumes as printed. Bold marks the hadeeth wording as the print sets it. Footnotes are the printed editors' notes; numbering restarts under each commentary, so it differs from the print. Use the button at the top to hide them. The hadeeth wording comes from the matn printed in Lamaʿāt.
